description: A 256 bit shift register read out as voltages. The bits are clocked along in sixteen columns of sixteen, and each column has an output carrying the voltage of the bits it holds

params.text: Scales the voltage arriving at the internal clock's rate input
Takes the bits from the internal random generator
Takes the bits from the internal VCO
Scales the voltage arriving at the internal VCO's frequency input
Scales the voltage of every column output
Offsets the voltage of every column output
Restricts the column outputs to unipolar voltages

inputs.text: An external clock for the shifting
A voltage setting the rate of the internal clock
A pulse switches the bit source between the internal random generator and the internal VCO
An external signal supplying the bits, overriding the internal random generator and the internal VCO
A voltage setting the frequency of the internal VCO

outputs.text: The clock as a train of pulses
The clock as a square wave
A ramp rising over each clock cycle
A ramp falling over each clock cycle
The voltage of the bits standing in that column

menu: Clean All Bits and Set All Bits — clear every bit, or turn every bit on
Poly channels from output 1 — turns the Column 1 jack into a polyphonic output carrying every column's voltage on its own channel
